notes: Four distinct localized state-change episodes are supported. The long camera surveys without manipulation were excluded. Side-shelf timing is less certain because camera rotation and close occlusion make the folded state difficult to distinguish.
scene_description: A user moves around a covered apartment balcony containing an adjustable white lounge chair and a stainless-steel gas barbecue, manipulating the chair backrest and several separate barbecue parts.
